caption: The image shows an illustration of a single sculpted hand, colored in gold with brownish markings that suggest wear or oxidation. The hand is depicted extending horizontally from the left side of the image, with the wrist encircled by two bands resembling a bracelet or decorative cuff. The hand's index finger and little finger are extended straight, while the middle and ring fingers are curled inward. A short, vertical rod extends upward from between the middle and ring fingers. The background is a plain, light beige color with no other objects or patterns present.
